name: CyberAlchemy Workspace
purpose: Coordinate the product meaning, capability ontology, DomainSpec-v2 construction chain, and future local interface through which a person can inspect CyberAlchemy definitions, products, projects, and ontologies without making the Project, repository, generated graph, or interface the authority for those records.
scope: one inspect-only Product Capability owned by the parent CyberAlchemy product
one capability-local ontology for definitions, products, projects, ontologies, snapshots, provenance, and project entry points
one DomainSpec-v2 source, deterministic compiled graph, and generated system ontology
one immutable realization candidate for a local CyberAlchemy Workspace frontend
Essays as the first projected Project entry, not as the owner of the Workspace
exclusions: treating CyberAlchemy Workspace as a new product, canonical definition registry, ontology authority, repository browser, or CAV2-D60 Project synonym
editing, accepting, promoting, publishing, or deleting semantic records from the first interface
moving Essays product meaning or runtime ownership into the Workspace
runtime implementation before exact digest-bound owner acceptance
publication, deployment, account systems, network synchronization, or external effects
challenge_route: Challenge Workspace product meaning and scope through the CyberAlchemy Workspace Project owner and CyberAlchemy v2 product owner, source meaning through each source owner, DomainSpec construction claims through the DomainSpec v2 owner, and interface behavior through the CyberAlchemy Workspace runtime owner.
